record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Determine whether the N = 2 supersymmetric KdV equation SKdV_1 is bihamiltonian, namely whether it admits a first Hamiltonian structure making it part of a bihamiltonian integrable hierarchy like the a = -2 and a = 4 cases.

evidence.quote: In that respect, the SKdV1 stands as one of the rare example of classical integrable system which is not (known to be) bihamiltonian. OP-5: Is SKdV1 bihamiltonian?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of N=2 supersymmetric extensions of the Korteweg–de Vries equation parametrized by a real constant a, written for an N=2 superfield Φ(x,θ₁,θ₂,t) as
    Φ_t = −Φ_{xxx} + 3(Φ D₁ D₂ Φ)_x + ((a−1)/2)(D₁ D₂ Φ²)_x + 3a Φ² Φ_x ,
where D₁, D₂ are the standard N=2 superderivatives. For the three integrable values a ∈ {−2, 1, 4} of this family, the equation SKdV_a is known to be completely integrable and to possess a Lax representation. For a = −2 and a = 4, a bihamiltonian structure (a compatible pair of Poisson brackets generating the hierarchy through a recursion operator) is known.

Problem: For the remaining integrable case a = 1 (denoted SKdV_1), determine whether the equation admits a first Hamiltonian structure compatible with its known (second) Hamiltonian structure, so that SKdV_1 fits into a bihamiltonian integrable hierarchy in the same sense as the cases a = −2 and a = 4.
artifact.status_search_result: Kersten and Sorin (Phys. Lett. A 300 (2002) 397–406; arXiv:nlin/0201061) constructed an explicit bi-Hamiltonian structure together with a recursion operator for the N=2 supersymmetric α=1 (a=1) KdV hierarchy, thereby answering the question affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Bi-Hamiltonian structure of the N=2 supersymmetric α=1 KdV hierarchy
status_evidence.snippet: bi-Hamiltonian structure as well as a recursion operator connecting all symmetries and Hamiltonian structures of the N=2 α=1 KdV hierarchy are constructed in explicit form.
status_evidence.claim: A bi-Hamiltonian structure for SKdV_1 (a=1) is constructed explicitly.
